pages.title: Emerald Singularity
pages.text: Emeralds crushed into one bright green point. It is perfectly clear and seems to carry a faint scent of trade and villages. Light passing through it turns a deep, satisfying green. Every facet has merged into one, and yet it still seems faceted.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Emeralds are beryl coloured by chromium. I crushed a hoard of them in the Singularity Compactor until the crystal lattice collapsed into one brilliant green point.
$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Baryon Asymmetry.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Omniscience Catalyst.
